releases.body:
Fixes the sidebar meter for git/npm installs: the TUI entry now ships precompiled (dist/tui.js). OpenCode only runs its Solid JSX transform on plugin sources outside node_modules, so raw .tsx in an installed package froze every reactive expression at its initial value and the meter never drew.

Also updates CI/publish to rebuild dist, reject a stale artifact, and handle npm 12's pack --json shape.
